audit.summary: Released hierarchical ablation composes planner targets1,5,9,13 with a four-action IDM trained on endpoints4,8,12,16. Exact supported-horizon diagnostic demonstrates invalid temporal composition. Major is scoped to this core released comparator; historical Table4 binding remains Needs Evidence. Base LDP mean is.6225, not.65; main combined-data gains survive.
limitations: P1 — Hierarchical planner and IDM use incompatible endpoint times — Counterevidence: Dense implementation aligns correctly. Historical corrected branch/learned compensation/configuration could affect scores; no run binding. Hierarchical IDM also changes architecture. Static selectable configuration, no executed initialization.
P2 — Base LDP average is inconsistent with its task results — Counterevidence: LDP+Subopt mean.695 and LDP+both.945 remain above.635; prose about suboptimal-data use reasonably refers to +Subopt row.
